item.title: CVE-2026-80292
item.description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to session theft.

item.title: CVE-2026-80291
item.description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability. A local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive data, modification of critical resources, and disruption of appliance functionality.

item.title: Rubyipmi: red hat satellite: remote code execution in rubyipmi via malicious bmc username
item.description: A flaw was found in rubyipmi, a gem used in the Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) component of Red Hat Satellite. An authenticated attacker with host creation or update permissions could exploit this vulnerability by crafting a malicious username for the BMC interface. This could lead to remote code execution (RCE) on the system.

item.title: Kubevirt: kubevirt: vm administration denial of service via guest agent
item.description: A flaw was found in kubevirt. A user within a virtual machine (VM), if the guest agent is active, can exploit this by causing the agent to report an excessive number of network interfaces. This action can overwhelm the system's ability to store VM configuration updates, effectively blocking changes to the Virtual Machine Instance (VMI). This allows the VM user to restrict the VM administrator's ability to manage…

item.title: Webmin through 2.670 Stored XSS via Servers Index Discovery realhost Field
item.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Servers Index module that allows unauthenticated adjacent attackers to inject scripts via the realhost field of UDP discovery replies. Attackers on the same broadcast domain can answer discovery scans with HTML or JavaScript stored by find servers() and rendered unescaped by edit serv.cgi, executing in Webmin user sessions.

item.title: Command Injection in ASSA ABLOY Seawing SC-1000 WebConfig
item.description: ASSA ABLOY Seawing SC-1000 WebConfig is vulnerable to remote command injection via HTTP request. Due to the lack of input sanitization, a privileged attacker can inject shell metacharacters in the server parameter, resulting in arbitrary command execution as the root user on the operating system. This issue was fixed in version 1.5.14.

item.title: CVE-2026-80290
item.description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Race Condition vulnerability. A low privileged local attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized modification of data or service disruption.

item.title: Webmin through 2.670 Improper LDAP Certificate Validation in generic ldap connect
item.description: Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in generic ldap connect in ldap-client-lib.pl that accepts any LDAPS or StartTLS server certificate. Man-in-the-middle attackers can impersonate the LDAP server to capture the bind DN password, often the root DN, and return forged directory data.

item.title: NASA Core Flight System Limit Checker Watchpoint Processing lc watch.c LC WPOffsetValid integer overflow
item.description: A security flaw has been discovered in NASA Core Flight System Limit Checker up to 7.0.1. This affects the function LC WPOffsetValid of the file fsw/src/lc watch.c of the component Watchpoint Processing. Performing a manipulation results in integer overflow. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The pull request to fix this issue…

item.title: Vllm: vllm: image exif rotation & png trns transparency not normalized, causing mismatch between model input and expectations
item.description: A flaw was found in vLLM, an open-source library for large language model inference. This vulnerability arises from improper handling of image metadata, specifically EXIF orientation and PNG transparency (tRNS) data, during image processing. When images are converted to RGB, transparency information may be implicitly discarded or remapped, leading to unexpected rendering of transparent pixels and distortion of…

item.title: Keycloak-services: keycloak-services: admin api v2 client put reveals client-id existence to unauthorized callers
item.description: A flaw was found in the Admin REST API v2 of Keycloak. This component is used by administrators to manage realm configurations, including clients. The issue occurs because the API processes a client update (PUT) request and performs payload validation before verifying if the caller has the required permissions to view or manage that specific client. By sending a request with a mismatched client ID in the body, an…

item.title: Tenda RX3 httpd R7WebsSecurityHandler improper authentication
item.description: A vulnerability was determined in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11 multi. Impacted is the function R7WebsSecurityHandler of the component httpd. Executing a manipulation can lead to improper authentication. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

item.title: soapbar: verify envelope bsp accepts an unauthenticated embedded certificate (signature forgery / authentication bypass)
item.description: Impact verify envelope bsp() derived its trust anchor from the message it was verifying. It read the X.509 certificate out of the caller-untrusted wsse:BinarySecurityToken , validated only that certificate's not-before / not-after dates, and then verified the signature against that same certificate. There was no CA-chain validation, no issuer/subject allowlist, and no pinning. A successful verify envelope bsp()…

item.title: TwigView FileLoader may allow arbitrary file reads through user-controlled template paths
item.description: Impact If FileLoader::findTemplate() is supplied un-validated user controlled data, arbitrary files can be read. Patches 1.3.3 and 2.1.2 contain a fix for this issue. Workarounds Don't supply user controlled data to include and extends tags.

item.title: github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp permits denial of service through a malformed IPv4 payload length
item.description: In github.com/insomniacslk/dhcp/dhcpv4/nclient4, BroadcastRawUDPConn.ReadFrom does not validate that the IPv4 payload length is sufficient to hold a UDP header before calculating the DHCP payload length. A frame with an IPv4 total-length field specifying fewer than eight payload bytes results in a negative DHCP length, causing a panic in buf.Consume due to a negative slice bound.

item.title: etcd: CRL enforcement bypass on gRPC listener when --listen-client-http-urls is configured
item.description: Impact What kind of vulnerability is it? Who is impacted? When etcd is configured with --listen-client-http-urls to split the HTTP and gRPC client endpoints onto separate listeners, the --client-crl-file Certificate Revocation List is not enforced on the gRPC listener. A client presenting a revoked certificate is correctly rejected by the HTTP endpoint but continues to authenticate successfully over gRPC. Patches…

item.title: Filament: Password validity disclosure for accounts denied panel access on login page
item.description: When multi-factor authentication is enabled, the login page presents the multi-factor challenge before evaluating canAccessPanel() . For an account that canAccessPanel() denies, submitting the correct password renders the challenge while an incorrect password returns the generic failure message, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to confirm that a password is valid for that account. When email-based multi-factor…

item.title: Cakephp twig-view unserialize Twig filter allows arbitrary object deserialization
item.description: Impact The unserialize filter has no restriction on which classes are allowed. This can be used as a deserialization remote-code-execution gadget. Patches 1.3.3 and 2.1.2 contain a fix for this issue. The fix may impact backwards compatibility if you are relying on deserializing PHP objects in your templates. Workarounds Don't use the unserialize filter.

item.title: Drupal Core Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site.

item.title: Idunno AntiCsrf Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
item.description: Idunno AntiCsrf contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via object injection. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.

item.title: Optimizely Web Experimentation External Control of Critical State Data Vulnerability
item.description: Optimizely Web Experimentation contains an external control of critical state data vulnerability in its account signup flow that could allow an attacker to impersonate existing customer users and modify Project JavaScript. Successful exploitation can result in attacker-controlled JavaScript being distributed through Optimizely-hosted assets and executed in browsers visiting affected customer websites.

item.title: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
item.description: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.

item.title: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
item.description: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

item.title: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
item.description: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.

item.title: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
item.description: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.
